items.question: What are the defining attributes of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the object of description.
This cakra is characterized as a king.
This cakra possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a regal center distinguished by having eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper name or a metaphorical epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: But the sixth cakra is the king, having eight petals and a pericarp.
